# myst

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-001 — MyST directives and roles render as readable blocks](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-001.md) — When a document uses MyST admonitions, context tags, definition lists, text roles, sized figures, grid cards or table directives, the Studio SHALL show each as a readable block in the preview without a Sphinx build.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-002 — Context tags render as readable panels](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-002.md) — When a writer pastes prompt-style context tags, the Studio SHALL show each as a readable panel and SHALL NOT lose its content or run it as HTML.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-003 — Definition lists and inline text roles are typeset](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-003.md) — When a writer uses definition lists, subscript, superscript, abbreviations or keys, the Studio SHALL show them typeset.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-004 — Reference roles show where a link goes](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-004.md) — When a writer links to a heading, figure, table, equation or label with a reference role, the Studio SHALL show a link whose target is visible.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-005 — Constructs the preview cannot build stay visible and labelled](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-005.md) — When a document uses citations, a bibliography or an unknown directive, the Studio SHALL show an inert, labelled placeholder for it.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-006 — Maths is typeset offline and bad formulas stay readable](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-006.md) — When a document contains inline, display or aligned maths, the Studio SHALL show it typeset without network access, and keep an invalid formula readable.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-007 — Sphinx configuration gaps are reported before building](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-007.md) — When a Sphinx project's configuration does not enable MyST syntax used in a document, the Studio SHALL tell the author which syntax is missing and where, through a non-intrusive closable banner that opens the Problems view, without running the configuration file.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-008 — Figure width and alignment show in the preview](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-008.md) — When a writer sets a figure's width or alignment, the Studio SHALL show the figure at that width and alignment.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-009 — A writer sees, links and renames labels safely](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-009.md) — When a document defines a label or links to a heading, figure, table, equation or label with a reference role, the Studio SHALL show an anchor icon next to the label target and a link whose target is visible, and apply a rename from the anchor as one undoable edit that tells the writer how many references still use the old name, or explain why it refuses.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-010 — A label can be renamed safely from its anchor](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-010.md) — When a writer renames a label from its anchor icon, the Studio SHALL apply it as one undoable edit, or explain why it refuses.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-011 — Grid cards adapt to the pane width](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-011.md) — When a writer lays out content with grid cards, the Studio SHALL show the cards in a layout that adapts to the pane width.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-012 — A toctree shows the linked documents and marks missing ones](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-012.md) — When a document contains a table of contents directive, the Studio SHALL list the documents it names as links and mark missing ones.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-013 — Table directives render as ordinary tables](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-013.md) — When a document uses list, caption or CSV table directives, the Studio SHALL show them as ordinary tables.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-014 — A closable banner warns about configuration syntax warnings](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-014.md) — When the Sphinx configuration check finds syntax warnings, the Studio SHALL show a non-intrusive closable banner that opens the Problems view, including in Restricted Mode.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-015 — Admonitions and context tags read as distinct callouts](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-015.md) — When a document uses a MyST admonition of any kind, including version admonitions and Quarto callouts, or a pasted context tag, the Studio SHALL show it in the preview, without a Sphinx build, as a titled callout whose body stays Markdown, nested and collapsible as written, and SHALL keep a tag it does not group visible as text.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-016 — Grids, cards and tabs lay out a document in the preview](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-016.md) — When a document uses MyST grids, grid cards, standalone cards or tab sets, the Studio SHALL show them in the preview, without a Sphinx build, as columns that follow the pane width, cards with their header, title, body and footer, and tabs that show one panel at a time and follow the click and the keyboard.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-017 — Figures and tables show as the source sizes and shapes them](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-017.md) — When a document uses a MyST figure, a table directive or a raw HTML table, the Studio SHALL show it in the preview, without a Sphinx build, with the image, caption, width and alignment the source gives, and as an ordinary table whose content stays as authored.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-018 — Definition lists and inline roles are typeset in the preview](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-MYST-018.md) — When a document uses MyST definition lists or the inline roles for subscript, superscript, abbreviations, keys, documents and downloads, the Studio SHALL typeset them in the preview without a Sphinx build, and SHALL keep a numbered reference it cannot number as inert text.
